annotations.text:
KEEP IT YELLOW.

The half height is a weak signal at 30pt with 9pt corners — a half-filled blue square and a full blue square are 15pt apart, and you read this board by sweeping it, not by studying one square. Yellow separates in peripheral vision; height does not.

It is also the honest colour: a partial square pays 5 XP where a done one pays 10. A mark wearing the done colour while paying half tells the person something untrue about their week.

Keep the yellow BORDER too, not just the fill. At half height the ring is what says "there is a mark here" from across the screen.

REVISING WHAT I SAID EARLIER.

I called the overlap with a counted habit a cost of this option. Having built it, it is smaller than I made it sound: both marks mean "part of this day happened", so sharing a colour is correct, and the number is simply the extra thing one of them knows.

The one real risk is a counted habit rendering a part-done square WITHOUT its number — then a missing number reads as a bug rather than as meaning. So that number must never be optional.
